taxon.wikipedia_summary: Valeriana calcitrapae is a species of annual herb in the family Caprifoliaceae. Individuals can grow to 18 cm tall. It is native to the Mediterranean Basin, Crimea, and Macaronesia (the Azores, Canary Islands, and Madeira).
